# Lady J website: SVG icon set

All icons use a 48 × 48 grid. Most use `stroke="currentColor"`, so the `color` attribute on the `<svg>` tag sets the line color. Change `color` and the size (`width` and `height`) as needed. The quote mark is a filled shape, so its color is set by `fill`.

Colors: chocolate `#5E2E12`, caramel `#A6540B`, cream `#F3EDED`.
